scope: 1 mm x 10 mm bump at 100 mm/s, B+S=2 kg, 5-50 N and 0-90 degrees, true force within 0.5 N throughout.
selectionScope: Fixed corrected-Coulomb/contact-gate both-rigid controller: actual force RMS0.02 N, S-A position RMS1 um, four corners x four seeds. Separate +/-0.01 and +/-0.02 N uncalibrated force bias at known100 us latency, then matched known200 us force latency. Current/force-filter/position latency100 us. Each group worst case repeated at25 and12.5 us plant step; no control-weight retuning.
measurementScope: Actual B/S load cell with 1.4 kg downstream, exact static gravity tare: Fc minus 1.4 times surface acceleration. Observer uses the matching measurement row; no surface or actual robot truth enters it. Issued robot commands drive a causal nominal predictor.
